test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Two persons P and Q working together can do a piece of work in 18 days. Q alone can do it in 36 days. Q started the work, and after working for 6 days he left the work. P then took up the remaining work. How many days will P take to complete the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

P and Q working together can do a piece of work in 18 days.

Q alone can do it in 36 days.

Q works for 6 days before leaving.

**Concept: **

Work = Rate x Time

**Solution:**

⇒ If Q alone can complete the work in 36 days
